section: Rajput states and society; Chandella (Khajuraho), Solanki (Dilwara, Modhera), Paramara contributions

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched regarding theories of Rajput origin and their proponents?
accepted.x: The foreign-origin theory, which associates the Rajputs with Scythians, Hunas and Gurjaras, was propounded by Col. James Tod and V.A. Smith. G.H. Ojha and C.V. Vaidya supported the Kshatriya-descent theory, while the Agnikula tradition is associated with Chand Bardai’s Prithviraj Raso.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure author–theory pair and eliminate the swapped proponents.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Agnikula theory of Rajput origin:
1. It traces the origin of certain Rajput clans to a sacrificial fire at Mount Abu.
2. Chand Bardai’s Prithviraj Raso is associated with this tradition.
3. It identifies Chauhans, Paramaras, Chalukyas or Solankis and Pratiharas as the traditional four Agnikula clans.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Agnikula tradition describes the clans as emerging from a sacrificial fire at Mount Abu and is recorded in association with Chand Bardai’s Prithviraj Raso; the four traditional clans are Paramara, Pratihara, Chauhan and Solanki.
accepted.tq: Test the complete traditional list while checking whether the origin legend and its literary association are both retained.

accepted.s: The theory that the Rajputs had foreign origins, including Scythian, Huna and Gurjara elements, was advocated by:
o: Col. James Tod and V.A. Smith
accepted.x: Col. James Tod and V.A. Smith advocated the foreign-origin theory of the Rajputs, associating them with Scythian, Huna and Gurjara elements.
accepted.tq: Use direct scholar–theory recall, with nearby historians as distractors.

accepted.s: The Kshatriya or ancient Indian descent theory of Rajput origin was supported by:
o: Col. James Tod and V.A. Smith
accepted.x: G.H. Ojha and C.V. Vaidya supported the view that the Rajputs descended from ancient Indian Kshatriyas.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the two commonly confused scholarly groups associated with Rajput-origin theories.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Valabhi is a Nagara shikhara type characterised by a barrel-vaulted form; it is not the name of the Odisha regional school. Odisha or Kalinga is associated with the Rekha deul, Khajuraho with the Chandelas, and Maru-Gurjara with the Solanki tradition.
accepted.tq: Find the category error by distinguishing a tower type from a regional school.

accepted.s:
With reference to the Maru-Gurjara style, consider the following statements:
1. It is associated with the Solanki tradition.
2. It developed in the Gujarat-Rajasthan region.
3. It belongs broadly to the period from the eleventh to the thirteenth century.
4. It represents a fusion of the Maha-Maru and Maha-Gurjara traditions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Maru-Gurjara is a Solanki-associated Nagara sub-style of Gujarat and Rajasthan, broadly dated to the eleventh–thirteenth centuries, and combines the Maha-Maru and Maha-Gurjara traditions.
accepted.tq: Check the dynasty, region, period and stylistic derivation as separate components of one architectural identification.

accepted.s: Which architectural feature is often associated with the Maru-Gurjara sub-style?
accepted.x: The Maru-Gurjara style, associated with the Solanki tradition of Gujarat and Rajasthan, often includes a Kirti-torana.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific architectural feature attached to the regional style, not merely its geographical location.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Bhojshala:
1. The Madhya Pradesh High Court declared Bhojshala a Hindu temple on the strength of Archaeological Survey of India findings.
2. The ASI survey of Bhojshala was ordered in 2024.
3. Under a 2003 ASI arrangement, members of both communities worshipped there on separate days.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Madhya Pradesh High Court relied on ASI findings in declaring Bhojshala a Hindu temple; the survey was ordered in 2024, while the 2003 arrangement provided for worship by the two communities on separate days.
accepted.tq: Combine judicial finding, survey year and administrative arrangement without confusing their sequence.

accepted.s: With reference to the solarisation of Modhera, which one of the following is correct?
o: A 6 MW plant with 15 MWh storage was inaugurated on 9 October 2022 at a cost of ₹76.66 crore.
A 60 MW plant with 15 MWh storage was inaugurated on 9 October 2022 at a cost of ₹766.6 crore.
A 6 MW plant with 15 MWh storage was inaugurated on 18 May 2026 at a cost of ₹76.66 crore.
A 15 MW plant with 6 MWh storage was inaugurated on 9 October 2024 at a cost of ₹67.66 crore.
accepted.x: Modhera was fully solarised under an MNRE scheme through a 6 MW plant and 15 MWh storage system. The project, costing ₹76.66 crore, was inaugurated on 9 October 2022.
accepted.tq: Check the plant capacity, storage capacity, date and cost as a combined numerical set.
